QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts] Danger! Danger! High Voltage!
QuestInfo.0: #bPhoebe#k needs your help, and it seems urgent. Go and see her.
QuestInfo.1: A Wondroid is demonstrating behavioral problems and is scheduled for a gruesome debugging.\r\nIn order save this Wondroid from harm, you need to obtain #b3 keys#k from the #b3 types of Aspire Guardroids#k that appear in #bInvestigation Mode#k.\r\n#bSneak into Aspire in investigation mode#k by talking to #bSpencer#k!
QuestInfo.2: You obtained the necessary keys and succeeded in rescuing Wondroid #bKat#k from the interrogation room.

0.msg: You haven't found all #b3 keys#k yet. You all of them. Perform an\r\n#r[Investigation Mode]#k through #bSpencer#k and defeat #bAspire Guardroids#k.\r\n
